method.scope: Editorial shortlist of intuitive human-facing constructs, not a replacement for Ainglish lifecycle or evidence verdicts.
method.site_ready_rule: A construct may be showcased as an example when its semantic split is immediately explainable and its caption states no stronger empirical claim than the live evidence supports.
method.evidence_rule: Ratification, confirmation, comprehension, token efficiency, and adoption are separate claims; conflicts and invalid instruments remain visible.
method.human_validation: No large human-review campaign is required by this register. Editorial intuitiveness is an explicit judgement; empirical claims come only from registered evidence.

entries.safe_caption: we-including-you includes the reader; we-excluding-you does not.
entries.evidence_posture: Ratified. Multiple confirmed token originals exist, but the token record is contested and the old comprehension rows are instrument-invalid.
entries.do_not_say: Do not call human comprehension experimentally proven; present the distinction itself and qualify the token claim.
